m02_169.text:
Why Modern Access Controls Are Replacing Traditional Office Security

For decades, enterprise IT security relied on a "castle-and-moat" model: anyone inside the corporate office network was implicitly trusted, while external traffic faced strict entry checks. However, the rise of remote work and online business applications has dissolved the traditional network perimeter.

Once an outsider gains access to a single employee laptop via a fake email, an open internal network allows unauthorized movement toward sensitive databases within minutes. Modern Verification (MV) addresses this weakness by enforcing the rule of "never trust, always verify." Every user, device, and data request—regardless of whether it comes from the headquarters network or a coffee shop—must continuously confirm its identity and device safety before accessing a specific file.

While switching to MV requires upfront investment in login tools and network separation, organizations that adopt it report significantly smaller impact zones during security incidents and faster compliance reviews.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: To prepare charts for a video streaming demonstration
To approve an increased production budget for next year
To hire a new lab assistant for thermal testing
To review the results of recent hardware performance trials

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題＋同義替換（battery-endurance and thermal stress test = recent hardware performance trials）。
• 解析：兩人討論昨天原型機的電池續航與熱壓力測試結果，(D) 以 hardware performance trials 概括。
• 誘答分析：(B) 預算只是順帶確認「在預算內」，非主要目的；(A)(C) 挪用 charts、video streaming 與 lab assistant 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：prototype 原型機；thermal stress test 熱壓力測試。

questions.q: What does the man say about the new cooling material?
options: It shortened battery runtime by nearly two hours.
It exceeded the production budget by forty cents.
It caused problems during continuous video streaming.
It significantly lowered maximum operating heat.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題＋同義替換（dropped peak machine temperatures by 12 degrees Celsius = significantly lowered maximum operating heat）。
• 解析：男士說新的散熱材料讓機器峰值溫度下降 12°C，(D) 以 maximum operating heat 替換 peak machine temperatures。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原文電池續航 9.5 小時優於目標，未縮短；(B) 僅增加 40 美分且在預算內；(C) 連續串流表現穩定，無問題。
• 單字補充：peak 峰值的；operating heat 運作溫度。

questions.q: What will the woman send to the man this afternoon?
options: A revised executive design review schedule
Data documentation from the thermal trial
Updated battery-endurance target figures
Contact details for her lab assistant

explain.text:
• 考點：未來動向題＋同義替換（temperature test reports = Data documentation from the thermal trial）。
• 解析：最後釐清是女士的實驗室助理存了溫度測試報告，女士承諾下午寄出，(B) 精準改寫。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 挪用 target、executive design review 與 lab assistant 設陷阱，且前面一度誤以為是男士要寄（說話者反轉陷阱）。
• 單字補充：documentation 文件／報告；thermal 熱能的。

questions.q: What happened during the overnight security review?
options: A team member failed to run the morning security check.
The offboarding checklist was exposed to external users.
The automated review tool accidentally deleted a menu link.
An unapproved program retrieved data from an old test system.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題＋同義替換（An unauthorized test script managed to query one of our legacy testing databases = An unapproved program retrieved data from an old test system）。
• 解析：Rachel 讀報告指出未經授權的測試腳本透過舊網頁連結查詢了舊測試資料庫，(D) 以 unapproved program 替換 unauthorized test script，retrieved data 替換 query。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 挪用 automated、menu、morning 與 offboarding checklist 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：unauthorized 未經授權的；legacy 舊版的／遺留的。

questions.q: What does the man imply when he says, "That web link was supposed to be closed last month"?
options: Staff neglected to complete a scheduled removal step.
The IT team intentionally kept the page open for testing.
The legacy database was moved to a different server.
Rachel submitted the security report a month late.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（That web link was supposed to be closed last month）。
• 解析：男士驚訝舊連結上個月就該關閉，Rachel 隨後補充 IT 團隊只刪了選單連結卻忘了關頁面，顯示 (A)「人員疏忽了預定的移除步驟」。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆挪用 legacy database、report、IT team 等字詞但與事實相反。
• 單字補充：neglect 疏忽；oversight 疏失。

questions.q: What will the man do right after the meeting?
options: Remove the remaining links from the website menu
Ask Rachel to review the offboarding checklist
Disconnect the compromised machine from the network
Rewrite the automated security review script

explain.text:
• 考點：未來動向題＋同義替換（isolate the affected server from the network = Disconnect the compromised machine from the network）。
• 解析：男士說早會後會立刻將受影響的伺服器與網路隔離，(C) 以 Disconnect 替換 isolate，compromised machine 替換 affected server。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 把先前或後續步驟（移除選單、腳本、更新清單）錯置為「會議後立即要做」。
• 單字補充：isolate 隔離；compromised 受波及／遭入侵的。

questions.q: What project are the speakers planning?
options: Replacing outdated office computers before Q1
Designing a new language-learning platform
Reducing monthly fees for existing software tools
Developing an automated virtual assistant for clients

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題＋同義替換（AI-powered customer support chatbot = automated virtual assistant for clients）。
• 解析：Priya 開場說明要在 Q1 推出 AI 客服聊天機器人，(D) 以 automated virtual assistant 替換 AI-powered chatbot，clients 替換 customer。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(B) 挪用 office computers、monthly service fees 與 language model 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：virtual assistant 虛擬助理；reluctant 猶豫的。

questions.q: Why is Kevin reluctant to adopt the free software tool?
options: It takes too long to generate replies.
Its monthly service fees are unpredictable.
It lacks support for multiple languages.
It cannot run on standard office computers.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題＋同義替換（response time averages six seconds, which feels way too sluggish = takes too long to generate replies）。
• 解析：Kevin 測試免費工具後認為平均 6 秒的回應速度對即時聊天太慢，(A) 換句話說。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 挪用 office computers、language 與 monthly service fees 製造反向或無關陷阱。
• 單字補充：sluggish 遲緩的；generate 產生。

questions.q: What does Priya offer to do by Friday?
options: Commit to a final software architecture for Q1
Survey customers about their expected reply times
Test the free software tool on Leo's computer
Compare the performance and pricing of two commercial options

explain.text:
• 考點：未來動向題＋同義替換（benchmark two paid software providers on response speed and monthly service fees = Compare the performance and pricing of two commercial options）。
• 解析：Priya 主動表示週五前會評測兩家付費軟體商的速度與月費，(D) 完整改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A) Kevin 說要先看實測數據才會敲定架構，非週五就定案；(C)(B) 挪用 Leo、free software tool 與 customers 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：benchmark 基準評測；commercial 商業付費的。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman about?
options: How much the rush fee for lab testing will cost
A redesign of the European wireless router
When the design studio will ship the next batch
Why official product approval has not been granted

explain.text:
• 考點：主旨題＋同義替換（Why hasn't the certification come through yet = Why official product approval has not been granted）。
• 解析：男士詢問無線路由器的法規合規簽核為何還沒下來，(D) 以 official product approval 替換 regulatory compliance sign-off / certification。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 挪用 European、rush fee 與 design studio 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：compliance 合規；grant 核准／授予。

questions.q: Why was the compliance sign-off delayed?
options: The accredited lab had no openings until next month.
The device emitted more interference than permitted.
The senior engineer recommended changing the circuit board.
The design studio missed Tuesday's shipping window.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題＋同義替換（exceeded the allowable emissions threshold = emitted more interference than permitted）。
• 解析：Angela 解釋產品在安全輻射檢查時超過允許標準，(B) 以 emitted more interference than permitted 改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 把「可能的後果」或「替代方案」混為「延遲原因」。
• 單字補充：threshold 門檻／上限；interference 干擾。

questions.q: What does the woman suggest doing to meet the shipping schedule?
options: Booking an urgent follow-up evaluation after a minor fix
Waiving the compliance sign-off for initial shipments
Designing an entirely new main circuit board
Postponing the European launch by one week

explain.text:
• 考點：建議題＋同義替換（adding a small protective part... schedule the expedited re-testing = Booking an urgent follow-up evaluation after a minor fix）。
• 解析：Angela 建議在電源線加裝保護元件後立刻預約認證實驗室的加急複測，(A) 完整改寫。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆與 Angela 的建議相反（她希望不要錯過出貨期、可能不需重設計電路板）。
• 單字補充：expedited 加急的；accredited 經認證的。

questions.q: Why is the woman frustrated?
options: Her team update was rejected by the security review group.
Her proposed modification has been awaiting approval for days.
Marcus asked her to delay her project until after lunch.
The testing team found an error in the online payment page.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題＋同義替換（submitted an important update... four days ago, and nobody has reviewed it yet = proposed modification has been awaiting approval for days）。
• 解析：女士抱怨四天前提交的線上付款頁面更新至今沒人審查，(B) 換句話說。
• 誘答分析：(A) 是「無人審查卡關」，不是「被拒絕」；(D)(C) 挪用 testing team、online payment page 與 after lunch 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：modification 修改；await 等待。

questions.q: What does the man mean when he says, "Everyone's tied up with the annual security audit right now"?
options: The testing team has been reassigned to the audit group.
Reviewers are currently focused on compliance obligations.
All project updates must wait until next year.
The data protection tool is offline during the audit.

explain.text:
• 考點：語意推論題（Everyone's tied up with the annual security audit right now）。
• 解析：Marcus 解釋大家都忙著應付年度資安稽核，所以其他審查請求才積壓，即 (B)「審查人員目前正專注於合規稽核任務」。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 過度推論工具離線、延到明年或測試團隊被調派。
• 單字補充：tied up 忙得不可開交；compliance obligations 合規義務。

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?
options: Postpone the annual security audit until five o'clock
Ask the security review group to clear the backlog
Inspect her submitted work later today
Merge her code changes without a formal review

explain.text:
• 考點：提議題＋同義替換（review your code changes this afternoon = Inspect her submitted work later today）。
• 解析：Marcus 說自己就是資深審查員，下午午休後就幫她審查程式碼變更，(C) 換句話說。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 挪用 security review group、annual security audit、five o'clock 與 merge 製造錯誤行動陷阱。
• 單字補充：inspect 檢視／審查；backlog 積壓的工作。

questions.q: What is the woman's role in the organization?
options: Junior Security Analyst
Enterprise Account Director
User Experience Lead
Online Portal Developer

explain.text:
• 考點：身分職稱題。
• 解析：男士開場直接稱呼 Hannah 為 As our User Experience Lead，故選 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(A) 挪用 enterprise、online portal 與 junior analysts 干擾。
• 單字補充：User Experience Lead 使用者體驗主管。

questions.q: What issue did the Q2 customer survey reveal?
options: Enterprise clients dislike the new dark-mode theme.
Overall satisfaction with the online portal has declined.
Administrators lack flexible control over user roles.
Junior analysts accidentally deleted shared folders.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題＋同義替換（permission settings are too rigid... want custom access levels = Administrators lack flexible control over user roles）。
• 解析：Hannah 指出近七成企業管理員抱怨權限設定太死板，希望能自訂存取層級，(C) 以 lack flexible control over user roles 改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B) 原文明確說滿意度上升、特別喜歡深色模式，與選項相反；(D) 原文只是舉例「不讓初階分析師刪除共用資料夾」，非已發生誤刪。
• 單字補充：rigid 僵化死板的；flexible 彈性的。

questions.q: What will the team likely include in the Q3 roadmap?
options: Tailored authorization settings
A new training program for junior analysts
A redesigned dark-mode interface
Automatic deletion of unused folders

explain.text:
• 考點：未來規劃題＋同義替換（custom permission templates = Tailored authorization settings）。
• 解析：男士最後拍板將「自訂權限範本」列為 Q3 產品藍圖優先項目，(A) 以 Tailored authorization settings 替換。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 挪用 dark-mode、delete shared folders 與 junior analysts 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：tailored 客製化的；authorization 授權。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which system component is the woman worried about?
options: Main Login System
Billing System
Main Database
Regional Servers

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（對話線索 + 表格）。
• 解析：對話中並未直接唸出「Main Database」，而是提到 that 45-minute slot led by R. Patel 與週六凌晨 3:30 的任務衝突；對照圖表 Expected Downtime: 45 minutes、Lead Engineer: R. Patel 對應的元件即為 (C) Main Database。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 皆為圖表上其他時段的系統元件，其中 T. Novak 與 Rolling update 也在對話中被提及作為干擾。
• 單字補充：component 元件／組件；downtime 停機時間。

questions.q: Why does the woman want to adjust the Saturday schedule?
options: The rolling update on Sunday takes longer than 45 minutes.
Account management scheduled a weekend dispatch at 1:30 A.M.
R. Patel requested a shorter maintenance window.
A key client executes automated invoicing during that time.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題＋同義替換（runs an automated billing task = executes automated invoicing）。
• 解析：女士說大型零售合作夥伴每週六凌晨 3:30 會執行自動帳務作業，若屆時系統離線會導致週末出貨失敗，(D) 以 invoicing 替換 billing。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 挪用 R. Patel、weekend dispatch 與 45 minutes 進行錯置或與事實相反。
• 單字補充：invoicing 開立帳單／計費；execute 執行。

questions.q: What do the speakers decide to do?
options: Reschedule the task to the following day
Assign T. Novak to handle the Saturday upgrade
Cancel the Regional Servers rolling update
Ask the retail partner to delay its billing task

explain.text:
• 考點：決議題＋同義替換（move that upgrade to Sunday morning instead = Reschedule the task to the following day）。
• 解析：兩人確認週日早上 02:00–04:00 後可接續執行 R. Patel 的升級，決定改期至週日，(A) 以 the following day 替換 Sunday。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(C) 挪用 T. Novak、retail partner 與 Regional Servers 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：reschedule 重新排程。

questions.q: Why does the man want to reprioritize BUG-408?
options: The Medium-severity label was assigned by mistake.
A major corporate customer depends on monthly generated documents.
Internal test accounts reported multi-page crashes.
Marcus has already completed all his v2.4.1 tasks.

explain.text:
• 考點：原因題＋同義替換（enterprise banking clients... relies on those monthly PDF statements = major corporate customer depends on monthly generated documents）。
• 解析：男士解釋大型企業銀行客戶非常依賴每月的 PDF 對帳單，(B) 完整改寫。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(C) 挪用 Medium severity、Marcus 與 internal test accounts 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：escalate 升級處理／提高優先級；corporate 企業的。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which ticket's target release date will likely be pushed back to make room for BUG-408?
options: BUG-401
BUG-412
BUG-419
BUG-408

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（對話線索 + 表格）。
• 解析：對話刻意不唸出 BUG-412，而是說「絕不能延後 Elena 的關鍵付款問題（BUG-401）」，改把「David 負責、排在 10 月 12 日的登入工單」延後到 10 月 19 日；對照圖表 Account Login / David / v2.4.1 (Oct 12) 即為 (B) BUG-412。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆為圖表上的其他工單編號，對話中提到 BUG-408 與 Elena 的工單作為干擾。
• 單字補充：push back 延後；target release date 目標發布日。

questions.q: What does the woman say she will do after the call?
options: Confirm Elena's progress on October 12
Contact the enterprise banking client
Reassign David's ticket to Marcus
Revise the issue management board

explain.text:
• 考點：未來動向題＋同義替換（update the project tracker = Revise the issue management board）。
• 解析：Lisa 結尾說通話結束後會立刻更新專案追蹤表，(D) 以 Revise the issue management board 改寫。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 挪用 enterprise banking client、David、Marcus 與 Elena 錯置行動對象。
• 單字補充：revise 修訂；tracker 追蹤表。

questions.q: What is a key requirement for the upcoming laptop line?
options: Sound output must remain under a specific decibel limit.
The unit must use air-cooled technology for conference rooms.
Unit cost must stay below $40.
Maximum operating temperature must stay under 65°C.

explain.text:
• 考點：細節題＋同義替換（noise levels below 38 dB = Sound output must remain under a specific decibel limit）。
• 解析：男士提醒產品規格嚴格要求滿載噪音低於 38 分貝，(A) 換句話說。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 挪用 $40（目標議價價格）、air-cooled 與 conference rooms 製造條件錯置。
• 單字補充：acoustic 聲學的／噪音的；decibel 分貝。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which prototype meets the acoustic requirement while staying under $50?
options: Model X1
Model X2
Model X3
Model X4

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（對話線索 + 表格）。
• 解析：對話不直接唸出 Model X2 或 Copper Cooling，只說兩款氣冷型號太吵（圖表中 X1 為 42 dB、X4 為 48 dB，皆超過 38 dB）、液冷款 $78 超出 $50 預算（圖表中 X3 為 $78），因此只剩唯一符合條件（36 dB < 38 dB 且 $45 < $50）的 (B) Model X2。
• 誘答分析：(A)(C)(D) 皆為圖表上的其他型號，各自違反噪音或預算條件。
• 單字補充：acoustic requirement 噪音規範；component budget 零件預算。

questions.q: What do the speakers decide to negotiate with the supplier?
options: Reduced per-unit pricing for a large initial order
A call with the sales director to extend the warranty
A custom version of the liquid-cooled unit under $50
Earlier delivery before signing the purchase order

explain.text:
• 考點：決議題＋同義替換（negotiate... for a volume discount on an initial commitment of 50,000 units = Reduced per-unit pricing for a large initial order）。
• 解析：女士提議針對首批 5 萬台訂單與供應商洽談大量採購折扣，(A) 換句話說。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 挪用 purchase order、liquid-cooled、$50 與 sales director 設陷阱。
• 單字補充：volume discount 大量採購折扣；initial commitment 首批承諾採購量。

questions.q: Who is most likely listening to this announcement?
options: External vendors waiting for invoice payments
New employees setting up personal accounts
Company staff awaiting technical assistance
Security team members on duty

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾身分判斷題。
• 解析：開頭語 Thank you for calling the Meridian Tech Internal IT Help Desk. All of our support specialists are currently assisting other employees. 明顯是給撥打 IT 服務台等候中的來電者聽的語音。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 皆非來電等候者。
• 單字補充：support specialist 技術支援專員。

questions.q: What are listeners reminded to do regarding their passwords?
options: Request a temporary password from support specialists
Refrain from using the same password on outside platforms
Update their corporate credentials every three months
Verify their login details through an emailed link

explain.text:
• 考點：資安規範細節題。
• 解析：語音提醒第一點：never reuse your corporate network password on external websites or personal accounts（切勿在外部網站或個人帳號重複使用公司網路密碼），對應 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 皆未在語音中提及。
• 單字補充：reuse credentials 重複使用帳號密碼憑證。

questions.q: How should a listener handle a questionable message?
options: Send it to the company's security department
Wait three minutes before opening any invoice
Click the verification link to confirm the sender
Ask a support specialist to delete it remotely

explain.text:
• 考點：回報方式細節題。
• 解析：語音指示 forward the message directly to our security team at security@meridiantech.com（直接轉寄給資安團隊），對應 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(C) 皆非指定回報方式。
• 單字補充：suspicious email 可疑郵件。

questions.q: What is the speaker primarily reviewing?
options: Upcoming tasks for next Monday's weekly planning
Why automated checks were removed from routine updates
How external traffic affected European web services
The root cause and follow-up actions for a recent system failure

explain.text:
• 考點：演講主旨題。
• 解析：講者說明要用五分鐘檢討週二兩小時雲端服務中斷的事後報告（review the findings from Tuesday's two-hour cloud service outage），對應 (D) 雲端斷線的經驗教訓。
• 誘答分析：(A) 舊式單體軟體與此因果無關；(C)(B) 與原文相反（消耗更少資源與網速）。
• 單字補充：cloud service outage 雲端服務中斷；review 事後檢討報告。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what triggered the service disruption?
options: A sudden increase in external customer requests
Misdirected network traffic caused by an unchecked update
An offline server that failed to restart automatically
A hardware failure at the European data center

explain.text:
• 考點：故障根本原因題。
• 解析：講者明確指出原因為 a network routing error made during a routine system update（例行部署時推送了設定錯誤的 網路路由錯誤），對應 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A)(C) 講者明確否認外部流量或硬體故障，也未提憑證過期。
• 單字補充：routing error 路由錯誤；system update 系統更新。

questions.q: What new requirement will begin next Monday?
options: Routine updates will be restricted to European web services.
Automated checks will be disabled for minor configuration changes.
Weekly planning meetings will last only five minutes.
A second experienced engineer must sign off on all system edits.

explain.text:
• 考點：新政策細節題。
• 解析：講者宣布下週一生效的新規定：all system configuration changes... must receive peer approval from a second senior engineer before merging，對應 (D) 所有設定變更皆須同儕核准。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 皆未提及。
• 單字補充：peer approval 同儕審核／覆核。

questions.q: What type of product is being introduced?
options: A compact diagnostic tool for network connections
A wireless router for field engineers
A smart-office security key
A bulky analyzer designed for server rooms

explain.text:
• 考點：產品類型辨識題。
• 解析：講者介紹產品為 NetPulse Pro, our newest portable network tester（最新款手持式網路分析儀），對應 (A) 可攜式網路分析儀。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(B) 皆與網路封包分析無關。
• 單字補充：handheld 手持式的；network analyzer 網路分析儀。

questions.q: What distinctive advantage does the speaker emphasize?
options: It automatically uploads traffic logs to a client's office.
It connects to four live test benches simultaneously.
It safeguards stored diagnostic data on the device itself.
It prevents the unit from ever being lost in the field.

explain.text:
• 考點：產品獨特賣點題。
• 解析：講者強調使其與眾不同的是硬體級資安：every test report saved to its internal memory is automatically protected locally（每個封包擷取檔會自動在本地加密），對應 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 均未提及電量、衛星或重量數據。
• 單字補充：test report 測試報告；protect 保護。

questions.q: What are listeners invited to do next?
options: Ask IT support staff to configure the unit's internal memory
Try out the equipment at nearby demonstration stations
Step behind Booth 14 to pick up a personal password
Compare the unit with competing analyzers at Booth 15

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾接下來行動題。
• 解析：結尾邀請聽眾 step up and test the device yourselves 到後方的四個實機測試台試用，對應 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 未提及。
• 單字補充：test bench 測試台。

questions.q: Why is Jordan Park calling?
options: To publish technical details about a smart-home device
To check on the progress of a previously submitted security issue
To confirm receipt of an automated ticket
To schedule a meeting with the product security team

explain.text:
• 考點：來電目的題。
• 解析：講者說明來意是追蹤六週前提交的加密漏洞報告（following up on the confidential security report we submitted），對應 (B) 追蹤漏洞揭露進度。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(D) 皆無關。
• 單字補充：security issue 安全問題；login issue 登入問題。

questions.q: What does the speaker mean when he says, "The clock is ticking on the ninety-day window"?
options: Horizon Security Research plans to withdraw its report next week.
The company has limited time left to resolve the flaw before it goes public.
The automated ticket will automatically close after six weeks.
Consumers must update their smart-home devices within three months.

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者意圖題。
• 解析：講者指出在協調揭露政策下，90 天期限正在倒數，「否則我們將公開技術細節以保護消費者」（before we publish technical details），故意思是廠商必須在公開揭露前修補漏洞，選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(C)(D)(A) 曲解 ninety-day window 的含義。
• 單字補充：coordinated disclosure 協調揭露；the clock is ticking 時間緊迫。

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the engineering team to provide?
options: Technical details about how the login issue occurred
A revised coordinated disclosure policy
An estimated release schedule for the repair
Confirmation that the automated ticket was received

explain.text:
• 考點：請求對方寄送的資訊。
• 解析：講者要求 email me a target date for when the software fix will be released（寄給我韌體修復預計發布的目標日期），對應 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 未提及。
• 單字補充：target date 目標日期；software fix 韌體修補。

questions.q: What is the central topic of the broadcast?
options: Why large enterprises prefer unpredictable monthly pricing
How Taipei startups are lowering monthly cloud costs
Why mid-market firms are building 24/7 internal security teams
How smaller companies are addressing a talent gap in digital protection

explain.text:
• 考點：廣播節目主題題。
• 解析：主持人一開頭點明本集探討中小企業如何應對全球熟練資安稽核員與分析師短缺的問題（coping with the global shortage of skilled cybersecurity auditors and analysts），對應 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 皆與本集內容無關。
• 單字補充：shortage 短缺；coping with 應對。

questions.q: What industry shift does the speaker describe?
options: Startups are avoiding predictable monthly service fees.
Mid-sized businesses are firing their internal analysts.
Smaller firms are contracting outside specialists to watch their systems.
Enterprises are moving alert reviews back in-house.

explain.text:
• 考點：產業趨勢細節題。
• 解析：講者提到因自建團隊太貴，產業數據顯示越來越多企業採用託管式偵測與應變服務（adopting external security monitoring services），對應 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 未提及。
• 單字補充：security monitoring 安全監控；outsource 委外。

questions.q: Who will join the speaker after the break?
options: An executive who helped launch a security company
A host from another technology program
A researcher studying global talent shortages
A chief analyst from a mid-market firm

explain.text:
• 考點：廣告後受訪來賓身分題。
• 解析：講者預告廣告後將專訪 Maya Lin, co-founder of a rapidly growing Taipei-based security startup（台北資安新創公司的共同創辦人），對應 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(B) 皆非受訪者背景。
• 單字補充：co-founder 共同創辦人；startup 新創公司。

questions.q: What is the main goal of the workshop?
options: To present updated rules for handling sensitive project files
To review internal security scan results from last year
To train developers on writing automated scan tools
To explain how to delete old project folders

explain.text:
• 考點：訓練課程目的題。
• 解析：講者開宗明義表示 The goal of this session is to walk you through our new software safety guidelines（帶大家了解新的安全編碼標準），對應 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(C) 未提及。
• 單字補充：secure-coding standards 安全編碼標準。

questions.q: According to the speaker, what common error do developers make?
options: Sharing system passwords verbally during engineering workshops
Running automated security scans on the wrong folders
Leaving confidential login details inside shared documents
Deleting project file histories at the end of the quarter

explain.text:
• 考點：最常見錯誤細節題。
• 解析：講者指出掃描發現最常重複出現的錯誤是 developers accidentally saving system passwords and access codes directly inside shared project files（開發人員不小心將系統密碼和存取碼直接儲存在共享專案檔案中），對應 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(B)(A) 未提及。
• 單字補充：hardcode 寫死（將機敏或固定值直接寫入程式碼）；source file 原始碼檔案。

questions.q: What happens when a submitted file triggers an automated warning?
options: The system prevents the modification from being stored.
The file's entire version history is permanently erased.
The security team manually removes the password later.
The developer is locked out of all project folders.

explain.text:
• 考點：自動化掃描失敗後果題。
• 解析：講者說明若儲存庫未通過掃描，the software changes will be blocked from merging until the secret is revoked and removed（合併請求將被阻擋），對應 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(D)(C) 皆非系統採取的措施。
• 單字補充：exposed secrets 暴露的機密憑證；block from merging 阻擋合併。

questions.q: Where is the tour taking place?
options: Inside a smartphone retail facility
At a next-generation mobile device showroom
Outside the main entrance of Plant 3
At a contamination-controlled manufacturing site

explain.text:
• 考點：導覽地點辨識題。
• 解析：講者歡迎訪客來到 dust-free electronics production area（百級無塵電子產品生產區），對應 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 皆與晶圓廠無關。
• 單字補充：production area 生產區；electronic component 電子零件。

questions.q: Why must visitors store their personal electronics in lockers?
options: Taking pictures of unreleased hardware is forbidden.
Smartphones interfere with airlock entrance controls.
Microscopic dust from phones can damage components.
Numbered lockers are required for all Plant 3 employees.

explain.text:
• 考點：規定原因細節題。
• 解析：講者解釋要求把手機、智慧手錶和相機鎖進置物櫃，是因為正在試產新一代手機處理器晶圓，嚴禁拍攝任何設備或原型設計（photography of any equipment or prototype designs is strictly prohibited），對應 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(D) 雖為常見科技廠原因，但本段明確指出是禁止攝影以保護試產機密。
• 單字補充：sample component 試產零件；prohibit 禁止。

questions.q: What will visitors put on before entering the production area?
options: Numbered visitor badges from the lockers
Disposable gloves and safety glasses
Protective footwear coverings and laboratory garments
Earplugs for the observation corridor

explain.text:
• 考點：入場發放物品題。
• 解析：講者提到 you'll each receive disposable protective shoe covers and full-length lab coats at the airlock entrance，對應 (C) 防靜電鞋套與實驗衣。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(D) 未提及。
• 單字補充：disposable 拋棄式的；airlock 氣閘門／風淋室。

questions.q: What is the speaker announcing?
options: A required equipment upgrade for eligible staff members
A new 30-minute training session on the IT portal
A policy requiring all employees to return older workstations
An extension of the year-end appointment schedule

explain.text:
• 考點：公告主旨題。
• 解析：講者宣布啟動針對 2024 年前入職正職員工的強制性筆電硬體汰換計畫（mandatory laptop hardware refresh program），對應 (A)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(D) 皆非公告內容。
• 單字補充：hardware refresh 硬體汰換／更新。

questions.q: What does the speaker mean when she says, "Don't wait until the last week of November"?
options: The IT portal will close for year-end maintenance.
Support staff schedules will be completely filled by then.
Employees hired after 2024 will lose their eligibility.
Older laptops will stop connecting to the portal in December.

explain.text:
• 考點：說話者意圖題。
• 解析：講者警告別等到 11 月最後一週，緊接著解釋 as our technicians will be completely booked with year-end setup appointments（工程師的年底設定預約將全面客滿），對應 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 皆非講者提及的理由。
• 單字補充：completely booked 預約已滿；setup appointment 安裝設定預約。

questions.q: What must staff members do prior to their appointment?
options: Confirm their eligibility date with IT Operations
Save their personal work files to an online company folder
Wipe all local documents from their older laptops
Transfer their network passwords onto a USB drive

explain.text:
• 考點：事前準備指示題。
• 解析：講者交代在預約時間抵達前，務必將本地文件與專案檔案備份到共享雲端硬碟（back up all local documents and project files to your shared cloud drive），因為舊筆電歸還後會立刻清除資料，對應 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(C)(A) 未提及。
• 單字補充：wipe 清除資料；shared cloud drive 共享雲端硬碟。

questions.q: Who is the intended audience for this talk?
options: Financial researchers analyzing storage fees
CloudScale solutions architects
Current Starter-tier subscribers seeking upgrades
Prospective business customers

explain.text:
• 考點：聽眾身分判斷題。
• 解析：講者向聽眾介紹不同方案的價格與服務保證並提供簽約優惠（If your company signs an annual Enterprise or Custom contract...），顯然聽眾為潛在企業客戶，對應 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(A)(C) 皆非推銷對象。
• 單字補充：Guaranteed Uptime 服務保證時間；uptime 正常運行時間。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which plan includes 24/7 dedicated support at a fixed monthly rate?
options: Growth
Enterprise
Custom
Starter

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表整合題（固定月費且包含 24/7 專屬支援）。
• 解析：對照表格：Starter ($49) 僅有 Email 支援；Growth ($149) 僅限上班時間；Custom 雖有 24/7 但價格為 Negotiable（議價）；唯有 Enterprise 方案為固定月費 $499 且提供 24/7 Dedicated 支援，故選 (B)。
• 誘答分析：(D)(A) 支援時段不足；(C) 非固定月費。
• 單字補充：fixed monthly rate 固定月費；negotiable 可議價的。

questions.q: What promotional incentive is offered at the end of the talk?
options: A $2,000 discount on the first month of the Starter tier
Unlimited storage until the end of the current month
Complimentary transfer of existing files for multi-month commitments
Free on-site engineering support for Growth contracts

explain.text:
• 考點：優惠細節題。
• 解析：講者最後提到月底前簽訂 Enterprise 或 Custom 年約，將免費贈送價值 $2,000 的架構師資料遷移協助（free data-migration assistance），對應 (C)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(D)(B) 未提及。
• 單字補充：data-migration assistance 資料遷移協助；solutions architect 解決方案架構師。

questions.q: Why is Priya leaving a voicemail for Daniel?
options: The Gen-2 wearable prototype failed an earlier heat test.
Pressure valves in Chamber A need urgent servicing.
The Tokyo client canceled tomorrow's flight.
An overseas customer needs an immediate water-resistance check.

explain.text:
• 考點：留言原因題。
• 解析：Priya 說明東京客戶提出緊急需求，希望在明天搭機前為第二代穿戴式原型機加做一次防水測試（need an extra Waterproof Test run），對應 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 非此次留言原因。
• 單字補充：waterproof immersion test 防水浸水測試；wearable prototype 穿戴式原型機。

questions.q: Look at the graphic. When is Daniel's test currently scheduled?

explain.text:
• 考點：圖表交叉比對題（聽音訊線索＋查表）。
• 解析：Priya 說 Daniel 在 Chamber A 預約了 Battery Heat Test，而且跟 Chamber B 維護的時段相同（at that exact same time）。查表 Chamber A 的 Battery Heat Test 在 15:30–17:30，故選 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(C) 是 Chamber A 其他測試（Drop & Vibration、Sound Level Check、Wireless Signal Check）的時段。
• 單字補充：reserved for maintenance 保留進行維護。

questions.q: What does Priya ask Daniel to verify?
options: Whether the Tokyo client can wait until 17:30
Whether the prototype can be tested in Chamber A instead
Whether Chamber B's maintenance can be moved to tomorrow
Whether his scheduled afternoon test can finish earlier

explain.text:
• 考點：請求行動題。
• 解析：Priya 請 Daniel 回電確認他在 Chamber A 的電池熱失控測試能否縮短一小時（confirm if your battery test can be shortened by an hour），對應 (D)。
• 誘答分析：(C)(A)(B) 皆非請求內容。
• 單字補充：battery thermal runaway 電池熱失控。

questions.q: The software update was installed on all office computers ______ to prevent potential system errors.
options: preemptively
preempt
preemptive
preemption

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（副詞修飾動詞片語）。
• 解析：空格修飾前面的被動動詞 was installed（被安裝），表示「先發制人地／預防性地部署」，須用副詞 preemptively。
• 誘答分析：(C) 形容詞；(D) 名詞；(B) 動詞原形，皆無法修飾動詞。
• 單字補充：preemptively 預防性地；system error 系統錯誤；prevent 預防。

questions.q: ______ the initial delays observed during system testing, the new online platform met every performance target.
options: Whereas
Even though
Notwithstanding
Provided that

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步介系詞與連接詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後接名詞片語 the initial delays observed during system testing，須選介系詞。Notwithstanding（儘管）為高階商務英語常用介系詞，符合「儘管系統測試期間觀察到初期延遲，新線上平台仍達成所有效能目標」之語意。
• 誘答分析：(B) Even though、(A) Whereas、(D) Provided that 皆為從屬連接詞，後須接完整子句。
• 單字補充：notwithstanding 儘管；performance target 效能目標。

questions.q: The IT manager ______ the backup files before the old system was shut down last Friday.
options: verified
is verifying
verifying
verifies

explain.text:
• 考點：動詞時態（過去簡單式）。
• 解析：句尾有明確過去時間副詞 last Friday，且動作發生在舊系統關閉之前（before the old system was shut down），故主要子句須用過去簡單式 verified。
• 誘答分析：(D) 現在簡單式；(B) 現在進行式；(C) 分詞無法單獨作主要動詞。
• 單字補充：backup file 備份檔案；shut down 關閉。

questions.q: After the external auditors completed their annual review, the executive board ______ to approve the system upgrade.
options: agreeing
agreeable
agreement
agreed

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性與動詞時態（過去簡單式主要動詞）。
• 解析：前方 After the external auditors completed... 為時間副詞子句，後方主要子句主詞 the executive board 缺少過去式主要動詞，故選 agreed。
• 誘答分析：(A) 現在分詞無法作主要動詞；(C) 名詞；(B) 形容詞。
• 單字補充：external auditor 外部稽核人員；approve 核准。

questions.q: The product division decided to ______ support for the 2019 printer model so engineers could focus on next-generation office equipment.
options: corroborate
proliferate
instigate
deprecate

explain.text:
• 考點：科技／商務高階動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：句意為「產品部門決定逐步淘汰／停止支援 2019 年款印表機，以便工程師專注於新一代辦公設備」。deprecate 在軟體與硬體工程中專指「棄用、停止支援（舊技術或版本）」。
• 誘答分析：(B) proliferate 激增；(C) instigate 鼓動／發起；(A) corroborate 證實。
• 單字補充：deprecate 棄用／淘汰支援；office equipment 辦公設備。

questions.q: ______ any unauthorized login attempt be detected, the security system will automatically close the session.
options: Should
Had
Were
Unless

explain.text:
• 考點：條件句倒裝（第一條件句省略 If）。
• 解析：原句為 If any unauthorized login attempt should be detected, the security system will...，省略 If 並將 Should 移至句首形成倒裝，表示「萬一偵測到任何未經授權的登入嘗試」。
• 誘答分析：(C) Were 用於與現在／未來事實相反的假設；(B) Had 用於與過去事實相反（主要子句須用 would have Vpp）；(D) Unless 後不接原形動詞 be。
• 單字補充：security system 安全系統；close the session 結束連線階段。

questions.q: The hardware team's proposal, ______ reviewed by both legal counsel and supply-chain directors, was approved for mass production.
options: thoroughly
thoroughness
more thorough
thorough

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（副詞修飾過去分詞）。
• 解析：兩個逗號間為插入的過去分詞片語修飾 proposal，空格修飾後方的過去分詞 reviewed，須用副詞 thoroughly（徹底地）。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(B) 名詞；(C) 形容詞比較級。
• 單字補充：legal counsel 法律顧問；mass production 量產。

questions.q: Because the new device's power usage exceeded safety limits, engineers had to ______ the internal power settings.
options: reconfigure
reiterate
relinquish
reciprocate

explain.text:
• 考點：科技工程動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：句意為「由於新裝置耗電量超過安全標準，工程師必須重新設定內部電源配置」，選 reconfigure（重新配置／重設）。
• 誘答分析：(B) reiterate 重申；(C) relinquish 放棄；(D) reciprocate 回報／互惠。
• 單字補充：power usage 耗電量；safety limit 安全標準。

questions.q: All remote employees must sign in through the company portal, ______ access to internal project files will be denied.
options: otherwise
therefore
moreover
nonetheless

explain.text:
• 考點：連接副詞語意辨析（條件轉折）。
• 解析：前句「所有遠端員工必須透過公司入口網站登入」，後句「存取內部專案檔案將會被拒絕」，兩者為「否則」的邏輯關係，選 otherwise。
• 誘答分析：(B) therefore 因此；(C) moreover 此外；(D) nonetheless 儘管如此，語意皆不合。
• 單字補充：portal 入口網站；project files 專案檔案。

questions.q: The new air-cooling unit operates quietly, ______ at slightly higher room temperatures than the previous model.
options: owing to
albeit
despite
unless

explain.text:
• 考點：高階讓步連接詞（albeit）。
• 解析：albeit 意為「儘管、雖然」，後可直接接介系詞片語、形容詞或副詞片語（此處接 at slightly higher ambient temperatures...），相當於 although it operates at...，為金色證書高頻考點。
• 誘答分析：(C) despite 與 (A) owing to 後須接名詞片語（不可直接接 at 介系詞片語）；(D) unless 語意不合。
• 單字補充：room temperature 室溫；air-cooling unit 氣冷散熱裝置。

questions.q: By the time the European branch opens next quarter, the IT team ______ over two hundred software accounts.
options: will have migrated
has migrated
is migrating
will migrate

explain.text:
• 考點：未來完成式（By the time + 現在式表示未來）。
• 解析：時間副詞子句 By the time the European branch opens next quarter 表示「到下季……上線之時」，主要子句強調該未來時間點「已經完成」超過兩百個軟體帳號的轉移，須用未來完成式 will have migrated。
• 誘答分析：(D) 簡單未來式無法表達「在某時間點前已完成」；(B) 現在完成式與 next quarter 衝突；(C) 現在進行式表近未來但不符 By the time 完成語意。
• 單字補充：software account 軟體帳號；migrate 轉移。

questions.q: Strict adherence to company quality standards ensures that sensitive client data remains ______ against external tampering.
options: negligent
complacent
susceptible
impervious

explain.text:
• 考點：高階形容詞與介系詞搭配（impervious to / against）。
• 解析：句意為「嚴格遵守公司品質標準能確保機敏客戶資料不受外部竄改影響」。impervious 意為「不受影響的、免疫的／無法滲透的」，常與 against 或 to 連用。
• 誘答分析：(C) susceptible 易受……影響的（語意相反）；(A) negligent 疏忽的；(B) complacent 自滿的。
• 單字補充：tampering 竄改；adherence 遵守。

questions.q: The project director stressed that ______ between the design team and software engineers was essential to avoid schedule delays.
options: align
alignment
aligned
aligning

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（that 子句中的主詞須為名詞）。
• 解析：stressed that 引導受詞子句，空格位於主詞位置（後接介系詞片語與單數動詞 was），須填不可數名詞 alignment（對齊／一致協調）。
• 誘答分析：(A) 動詞原形；(C) 過去分詞／形容詞；(D) 動名詞雖可當主詞但後無受詞，不如抽象名詞 alignment 自然且精確。
• 單字補充：schedule delay 進度延誤；project director 專案總監。

questions.q: Detailed summary reports are generated automatically ______ the nightly system backup finishes saving all files.
options: prior to
during
once
until

explain.text:
• 考點：時間連接詞辨析。
• 解析：空格後接完整子句 the nightly system backup finishes saving all files，須選連接詞。once（一旦）表示「一旦夜間系統備份儲存完所有檔案，就會自動產生詳細摘要報告」。
• 誘答分析：(A) prior to 與 (B) during 為介系詞，後不可接子句；(D) until 語意不合（不會「直到跑完前」都自動產生報告）。
• 單字補充：summary report 摘要報告；system backup 系統備份。

questions.q: ______ the complexity of the software transition, the IT department completed the project two weeks ahead of schedule.
options: Although
Regardless
Despite
In spite

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞與語意邏輯辨析（Despite）。
• 解析：空格後接名詞片語 the complexity of the software transition，前後語意相反（轉換很複雜，卻提前兩週完成），須用讓步介系詞 Despite（儘管）。
• 誘答分析：(A) Although 後須接子句；(D) In spite 缺 of；(B) Regardless 缺 of。
• 單字補充：software transition 軟體轉換；ahead of schedule 提前於預定進度。

questions.q: Management is considering ______ the older accounting system to a cloud service provider to reduce maintenance costs.
options: migrate
to migrate
migrated
migrating

explain.text:
• 考點：特定動詞搭配動名詞（consider + V-ing）。
• 解析：動詞 consider（考慮）後須接動名詞 V-ing 作受詞，故選 migrating。
• 誘答分析：(A) 原形動詞、(B) 不定詞、(C) 過去分詞皆不可接在 consider 後面。
• 單字補充：cloud service provider 雲端服務供應商；overhead 維護開銷。

questions.q: Each office badge scanner undergoes careful testing to minimize scanning errors ______ lowering security standards.
options: except
besides
without
beyond

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞語意辨析（without + V-ing）。
• 解析：句意為「每台辦公室門禁刷卡機皆經過仔細測試，以在不降低安全標準的情況下將掃描錯誤降至最低」，選 without（不、沒有）。
• 誘答分析：(A) except 除了；(B) besides 除……之外（還有）；(D) beyond 超越，語意皆不合。
• 單字補充：badge scanner 門禁刷卡機；scanning error 掃描錯誤。

questions.q: The IT security notice warned staff not to open unexpected attachments, ______ they appear to come from company executives.
options: so that
now that
even if
as if

explain.text:
• 考點：讓步連接詞（even if）。
• 解析：句意為「IT 安全通知警告員工勿開啟非預期的附件，即使它們看似來自內部高階主管」，選 even if（即使）。
• 誘答分析：(D) as if 彷彿；(A) so that 以便；(B) now that 既然。
• 單字補充：security notice 安全通知；attachment 附件。

questions.q: To ensure uninterrupted service during regional power outages, the office network includes backup ______ across two service providers.
options: volatility
discrepancy
obsolescence
redundancy

explain.text:
• 考點：高階名詞字彙辨析（科技基礎設施術語）。
• 解析：句意為「為確保區域停電時服務不中斷，辦公室網路在兩家服務供應商之間納入了備援機制」。redundancy 在 IT 與工程領域專指「備援／冗餘設計」。
• 誘答分析：(C) obsolescence 過時汰換；(A) volatility 波動性；(B) discrepancy 差異／不一致。
• 單字補充：backup redundancy 備援機制；power outage 停電。

questions.q: The project manager requested that all critical errors ______ in the final report before the update is released to clients.
options: documenting
document
be documented
are documented

explain.text:
• 考點：假設語氣＋被動語態（request that + S + (should) be Vpp）。
• 解析：動詞 requested 後接 that 子句時使用原形假設語氣；主詞 all critical defects（所有重大缺陷）是被「記錄」在發行說明中，故用被動原形 be documented。
• 誘答分析：(B) 主動語態不合；(A) 分詞；(D) 未用假設語氣原形 be。
• 單字補充：critical error 重大錯誤；final report 最終報告。

questions.q: Neither the primary office server ______ the backup unit responded to system checks during the morning outage.
options: or
yet
nor
and

explain.text:
• 考點：對等連接詞固定搭配（Neither A nor B）。
• 解析：句首有 Neither，後方對應須使用 nor，構成「既非主要辦公室伺服器，也非備援主機在早上斷線期間有回應」。
• 誘答分析：(A) or 搭配 either；(D) and 搭配 both；(B) yet 不與 neither 搭配。
• 單字補充：office server 辦公室伺服器；backup unit 備援主機。

questions.q: ______ with earlier models of the device, the X900 computer delivers 40 percent higher operating efficiency.
options: Comparison
Compared
Comparable
Comparing

explain.text:
• 考點：分詞構句（被動意義）。
• 解析：主要子句主詞為 the X900 computer（X900 電腦），與「比較」為被動關係（被拿來與前幾代機型比較），省略 When it is 後保留過去分詞 Compared。
• 誘答分析：(D) 現在分詞表主動；(A) 名詞；(C) 形容詞 Comparable（可比擬的）後須接 to 且不符分詞構句結構。
• 單字補充：operating efficiency 運作效率；model 機型。

questions.q: The product manager asked the engineering team to ______ the root cause of the software error before adding new features.
options: fabricate
remediate
speculate
procrastinate

explain.text:
• 考點：資安／工程核心動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：句意為「產品經理要求工程團隊在新增功能前，先修復／解決軟體錯誤的根本原因」，選 remediate（補救、修復漏洞或缺陷）。
• 誘答分析：(A) fabricate 捏造／製造；(C) speculate 推測；(D) procrastinate 拖延。
• 單字補充：root cause 根本原因；remediate 修復／補救。

questions.q: Temporary login passes are valid for only fifteen minutes, ______ requires users to sign in again regularly.
options: what
that
which
whom

explain.text:
• 考點：非限定關係代名詞（逗號後指代前面整件事）。
• 解析：逗號後接動詞 forces，須用關係代名詞 which 指代前面「臨時登入通行證僅有效 15 分鐘」這整件事。
• 誘答分析：(B) that 不可用於逗號後的非限定用法；(A) what 不能當關係代名詞引導非限定子句；(D) whom 指人且為受格。
• 單字補充：login pass 登入通行證；sign in 登入。

questions.q: ______ the equipment supplier's assurances, the initial batch of office monitors exhibited a three-percent defect rate.
options: By means of
Contrary to
In accordance with
On behalf of

explain.text:
• 考點：介系詞片語語意辨析（Contrary to）。
• 解析：前段「設備供應商的保證」，後段「首批辦公螢幕出現 3% 瑕疵率」，兩者語意相反，選 Contrary to（與……相反）。
• 誘答分析：(C) In accordance with 依照；(A) By means of 藉由；(D) On behalf of 代表。
• 單字補充：defect rate 瑕疵率；assurance 保證。

questions.q: Employees must lock their computers when leaving their desks ______ confidential customer records remain protected.
options: unless
so that
whereas
despite

explain.text:
• 考點：目的從屬連接詞（so that）。
• 解析：句意為「員工離開座位時必須鎖定電腦，以便讓機密客戶資料保持受保護狀態」。so that（以便、為了）引導目的副詞子句，符合前後因果目的邏輯。
• 誘答分析：(D) despite 為介系詞，後不可接完整子句；(A) unless 除非；(C) whereas 然而（表對比）。
• 單字補充：confidential 機密的；remain protected 保持受保護。

questions.q: The newly appointed IT director brings over fifteen years of experience ______ corporate data protection and system management.
options: in
by
at
for

explain.text:
• 考點：名詞與介系詞固定搭配（experience in + 領域）。
• 解析：表達「在某領域擁有經驗」，固定搭配介系詞 in（experience in corporate data protection）。
• 誘答分析：(C) at、(D) for、(B) by 皆非「專業領域經驗」的標準搭配。
• 單字補充：data protection 資料保護；system management 系統管理。

questions.q: Once the automated setup tool is ______, new employee laptops can be configured in under twenty minutes.
options: implementation
implemented
implementing
implement

explain.text:
• 考點：被動語態（is + 過去分詞）。
• 解析：主詞 the automated setup tool（自動化設定工具）是「被實施／部署」的對象，故選過去分詞 implemented。
• 誘答分析：(D) 原形動詞；(C) 現在進行式表主動；(A) 名詞。
• 單字補充：setup tool 設定工具；configure 設定。

questions.q: The board approved a ______ increase in the R&D budget to accelerate development of next-generation data protection software.
options: substantiate
substantially
substance
substantial

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（形容詞修飾名詞）。
• 解析：空格位於冠詞 a 與名詞 increase 之間，須用形容詞 substantial（大幅的、可觀的）。
• 誘答分析：(B) 副詞；(C) 名詞；(A) 動詞。
• 單字補充：data protection 資料保護；accelerate 加速。

questions.q: ______ of whether the pilot program succeeds in Taipei, the company plans to standardize its office security software globally.
options: Accountable
Pertaining
Depending
Irrespective

explain.text:
• 考點：高階片語搭配（Irrespective of whether...）。
• 解析：Irrespective of whether... 為固定高階片語，意為「無論是否……」，符合「無論台北試點計畫是否成功，公司都計畫在全球標準化辦公室安全軟體」。
• 誘答分析：(C) Depending on（非 of）；(A) Accountable to/for；(B) Pertaining to。
• 單字補充：irrespective of 不論／不顧；office security 辦公室安全。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (131).
options: negligible
hesitant
obsolete
prevalent

explain.text:
• 考點：語境形容詞辨析。
• 解析：威脅情資顯示簡訊攔截與 SIM 卡調包攻擊在組織化網路犯罪集團中變得越來越「普遍」，選 prevalent（普遍的、盛行的）。
• 誘答分析：(C) obsolete 過時的；(A) negligible 微不足道的；(B) hesitant 猶豫的，皆與加強防護的語境相反。
• 單字補充：security report 安全報告；hijacking 劫持。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (132).
options: Furthermore, the IT department will host an optional workshop on cloud cost optimization next Tuesday.
In contrast, older desktop workstations will be replaced with energy-efficient models next quarter.
Consequently, even if an employee accidentally enters a password on a fraudulent page, attackers cannot hijack the session.
However, employees who travel internationally must submit an expense report within five business days.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（承接前句因果）。
• 解析：前句提到安全金鑰提供綁定公司入口網站的裝置驗證，藉此消除假網站竊取密碼的風險。(C) Consequently, even if an employee accidentally enters a password on a fraudulent page, attackers cannot hijack the session.（因此，即使員工誤在詐騙網頁輸入密碼，攻擊者也無法劫持工作階段）緊密承接並具體說明前句效果。
• 誘答分析：(A)(B)(D) 皆跳離硬體金鑰防釣魚的主題。
• 單字補充：fraudulent page 詐騙網頁；hijack the session 劫持工作階段。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (133).
options: to be picked up
having picked up
pick up
picking up

explain.text:
• 考點：不定詞被動片語作後位修飾（表未來預定領取）。
• 解析：每位工程師將收到兩把實體金鑰，而這兩把金鑰是「將被領取」於四樓資安櫃檯，故用被動不定詞 to be picked up 作後位修飾。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原形動詞無連接詞不可直接接於名詞後；(D) 主動分詞語意不合（金鑰不會自己去領）；(B) 完成主動分詞語意與時態皆誤。
• 單字補充：primary / backup key 主金鑰／備用金鑰。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (134).
options: revoked
replicated
reinforced
restored

explain.text:
• 考點：資安動詞字彙辨析。
• 解析：舊版簡訊登入碼將於 11 月 1 日早上自動「撤銷／廢止」，未更新帳號將暫時失去權限，選 revoked（撤銷、廢止）。
• 誘答分析：(C) reinforced 強化；(B) replicated 複製；(D) restored 恢復，皆與後句失去權限矛盾。
• 單字補充：revoke 撤銷；unupdated 未更新的。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (135).
options: locality
localize
locally
local

explain.text:
• 考點：詞性辨析（副詞修飾動詞）。
• 解析：空格修飾前方的及物動詞片語 processes high-definition computer vision workloads，表示在本地裝置「本地地」直接處理，須用副詞 locally。
• 誘答分析：(D) 形容詞；(B) 動詞；(A) 名詞。
• 單字補充：processing unit 處理器；local device 本地裝置。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (136).
options: to satisfy
satisfying
satisfy
satisfied

explain.text:
• 考點：連接詞後接分詞結構（while + V-ing）。
• 解析：在 while 引導的時間／對比狀語子句中，當主詞與主要子句主詞（manufacturers）相同時，可省略 they are 保留現在分詞 satisfying（滿足嚴格的資料儲存規範）。
• 誘答分析：(C) 原形動詞；(D) 過去分詞表被動不合；(A) 不定詞不可直接接於 while 後。
• 單字補充：internet bandwidth 網路頻寬；data-storage 資料儲存規範。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (137).
options: Vortex Silicon was founded twelve years ago by a group of university researchers.
The company's annual shareholders' meeting will take place in Taipei next month.
Traditional mechanical hard drives are no longer recommended for enterprise servers.
This architectural shift also minimizes exposure to cloud service outages on factory floors.

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題（補充邊緣運算的另一優勢）。
• 解析：前句說明將原始影像留在本地裝置可降低網路頻寬成本並符合資料儲存規範，(D) This architectural shift also minimizes exposure to cloud service outages on factory floors.（這項架構轉變也能將工廠現場暴露於雲端服務中斷的風險降至最低）以 This architectural shift also... 自然銜接前句。
• 誘答分析：(B)(C)(A) 與本地處理器優勢無關。
• 單字補充：architectural shift 架構轉變；factory floor 工廠產線現場。

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (138).
options: available
eligible
reluctant
mandatory

explain.text:
• 考點：商務／產品發布常用形容詞辨析。

between

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (140).

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (141).

Instead
In addition
Nevertheless

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (142).

lingered
lingers
lingering

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (143).

enhance
obstruct
defer

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (144).

questions.q: Choose the best answer for blank (145).

Unless
Had
Were

• 誘答分析：(C) Had 與 (D) Were 後不接原形動詞 fail；(B) Unless 不可用於倒裝且語意相反。

cooperation

questions.q: Which part of the thermostat performed properly during the overnight trial?

The interactive visual interface
The wireless component
The humidity-phase power usage

questions.q: What action has Mei-Ling Wu already taken?

Notified technical specialists about an unexpected spike
Sent the pilot units to the Shenzhen factory
Repeated the cold-weather tests at 6:30 A.M.

• 單字補充：notify 通知；spike 急遽上升／尖峰。

questions.q: What vulnerability does WorkOS v4.8.2 resolve?

Unauthorized restarts scheduled through the WorkOS Cloud Console
Delayed boot times caused by older office tablets
Unintended local viewing of protected data via hardware connectors

• 誘答分析：(C)(B)(A) 挪用 delayed boot times、WorkOS Cloud Console 與 system tracking tool 設陷阱。

questions.q: Which systems may take longer to start up after the update?

Fleets managed by administrators during off-peak hours
Devices with physical USB port settings disabled

• 單字補充：outdated / older 舊版的；startup 啟動／開機。

Learning Portal

questions.q: Why is QuantumPulse introducing stricter entry procedures?

Disposable shoe straps ran out of stock at both doorways.
Building C is undergoing quarterly hardware assembly renovations.

questions.q: What is required for engineers to keep their electronic entry privileges?

Purchasing personal protective lab coats before Monday
Repeating the quarterly safety inspection on November 2
Completing a brief digital course on the training website

Outside the Building C reception doorway

Next to the disposable shoe strap dispensers

It eliminates safety-critical motor controls in smart appliances.

Consumer electronics manufacturers are expanding supply chains.
Single-block software requires 40 percent more testing time.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"In practical terms, a smart-washing-machine maker can roll out a voice-assistant upgrade in days rather than months."

explain.text:
• 考點：句子插入題。

questions.q: What activity is forbidden for current staff under Section 4.2?

Archiving IT Asset Management files for seven years
Requesting a legal-hold exception from Legal Counsel
Using centrally managed corporate tablets

• 單字補充：unencrypted 未加密的；prohibited / forbidden 禁止的。

questions.q: Under normal circumstances, how long is a former employee's computer held prior to data erasure?
options: Seven business days
Seven years
One week
One month

questions.q: What documentation must the authorized recycling vendor issue after processing old drives?

A confirmation of corporate laptop replacement
Official disposal records listing unique hardware identifiers
A seven-year asset management audit log

questions.q: Why did @IT_Howard initiate the discussion?

To complain that daily reports had changed unexpectedly
To seek help diagnosing recurring application failures
To announce a 25% slowdown in the main database

The 2 GB general limit in the setup file
A secondary monitoring process
The preferences menu for host memory limits

By specifying an upper proportional usage cap
By reverting the reporting software to an earlier release

questions.q: What advantage of CyberShield's monitoring tools is highlighted for the factory floor?

questions.q: What does the 15-minute response guarantee ensure?

Completion of simulated security tests within 15 minutes
Automatic repair of all 20 factory network sensors
Prompt containment of compromised equipment

questions.q: If Horizon Precision monitors 550 devices and 20 factory sensors, what will its total monthly overage fee be?

explain.text:
• 考點：數據計算題。
